info.title: Core Backend API
info.description:
Sign-in flow: **register or login** (email code, passkey or Truecaller) → optional **2FA** → **profile setup**.

- All bodies are JSON; unknown fields are rejected (400).
- Errors are `{"error": "message"}` with a matching HTTP status.
- Authenticated routes need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from a `Session`.
- `POST /v1/webhooks/oauth` is server-to-server, HMAC-signed and not rate limited.
- Rate limits per client IP: 120 requests/minute overall, 10/minute on register, login, 2FA verify/enable/disable and link. Exceeding them returns 429.

### Email codes
- 6 digits, valid for **10 minutes**, usable **once**.
- A new code can be requested after **1 minute** (429 before that). Requesting one replaces the previous code.
- **5 wrong attempts** delete the code; request a new one.
- Codes for register, login and link are separate: a login code can't complete a registration.

post.description:
Send the same endpoint twice for email and passkey:

| method | step 1 body | step 1 result | step 2 body | step 2 result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | `{method, email}` | `CodeSent` | `{method, email, code}` | `Session` |
| `passkey` | `{method}` | `PasskeyChallenge` (pass `options` to `navigator.credentials.create`) | `{method, challenge_id, credential}` | `Session` |
| `truecaller` | `{method, authorization_code, code_verifier}` | `Session` | | |

Passkey challenges expire after 5 minutes and work once.

### Email codes
- 6 digits, valid for **10 minutes**, usable **once**.
- A new code can be requested after **1 minute** (429 before that). Requesting one replaces the previous code.
- **5 wrong attempts** delete the code; request a new one.
- Codes for register, login and link are separate: a login code can't complete a registration.

New accounts never have 2FA, so registration always ends in a `Session`. `user.profile_complete` is false until the profile is set.

Passkey challenges expire after 5 minutes and work once.

### Email codes
- 6 digits, valid for **10 minutes**, usable **once**.
- A new code can be requested after **1 minute** (429 before that). Requesting one replaces the previous code.
- **5 wrong attempts** delete the code; request a new one.
- Codes for register, login and link are separate: a login code can't complete a registration.

### Two-factor
If the account has 2FA on, email and Truecaller logins return `MFAChallenge`; finish with `POST /v1/auth/2fa/verify`. Passkey logins skip 2FA (a passkey is already two factors).

post.summary: Receive a connection event from the OAuth service
post.description:
Called by the OAuth service, not by apps.

Signed with a shared secret (`OAUTH_SERVICE_SECRET`):

```
X-Webhook-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>
```

The timestamp must be within 5 minutes of the server clock. Sign the exact bytes you send.

**Retries:** any 2xx means done, don't retry. Retry on 5xx or network errors with the same event `id`; duplicates are ignored. Events can arrive out of order; `occurred_at` decides which one wins.

The endpoint is not rate limited per IP. It returns 503 until the secret is configured.

400.description: Invalid event; fix it, don't retry

value.error: account.id is required for connected and updated events

value.error: user_id is not a valid id

post.description:
Returns a `connect_url` on the OAuth service. The user finishes the provider's OAuth there. The OAuth service then sends a `connection.connected` webhook, after which this connection and the profile flag show `connected: true`.

Contract for the OAuth service: the URL is `{OAUTH_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/v1/connect/{provider}?token=<JWT>`. The JWT is HS256 signed with the shared secret, with `iss=core-backend`, `aud=oauth-service`, `sub=<user id>`, a `provider` claim and a 10-minute `exp`. Use `sub` as `user_id` in webhooks.

delete.description:
Asks the OAuth service to revoke its tokens, then removes the stored account and sets the flag to false. If the OAuth service doesn't confirm, nothing changes here (502), so a later webhook can't silently reconnect it.

Contract for the OAuth service: `POST {OAUTH_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/v1/connections/revoke` with body `{"user_id","provider","requested_at"}` and an `X-Webhook-Signature` header (same scheme as the webhook). Reply 2xx, or 404 if nothing is held.

code.description: email step 2: code from the email

credential.description: passkey step 2: PublicKeyCredential JSON from navigator.credentials.create/get

authorization_code.description: truecaller: from the Truecaller OAuth SDK

code_verifier.description: truecaller: PKCE verifier used for that code

CodeSent.description: Email sent; repeat the request with `code`.

MFAChallenge.description: Login needs an authenticator code: POST /v1/auth/2fa/verify.

Linked.description: Method linked; user shows the updated sign-in methods.

AuthResult.description: One of the step results. Tell them apart by which field is present: `status`, `challenge_id`, `mfa_token`, `token`, or `user` alone.

username.description: lowercase letters, digits, . and _; no repeated . or _; some names are reserved

ProfileInput.description: Profile to save. All rules are enforced; violations return 400.

Profile.description: Saved profile. Fields are empty strings until profile setup is done.

profile_complete.description: false until name, username and dob are set: send the user to profile setup

passkeys.description: base64url credential ids; pass one as credential_id to unlink it

reason.description: empty when available; otherwise taken, reserved, or the format rule that failed

metadata.description: Provider-specific extra fields, stored as sent

ConnectionAccount.description: Profile info from the provider. Access/refresh tokens stay in the OAuth service and are never sent here.

updated_at.description: Absent if the provider was never connected

id.description: Unique per event; resending the same id is a no-op (deduplicated for 7 days)

occurred_at.description: When it happened at the OAuth service. Used for ordering: an event older than the stored one is ignored. Max 5 minutes in the future.

account.description: Required for connected and updated; ignored for disconnected

status.description: applied: stored. duplicate: event id already processed. stale: a newer event for this user and provider is already stored. ignored_unknown_user: no such user.

ConnectionFlags.description: Every provider mapped to whether it is connected. Always contains all providers.

connect_url.description: Open this in a browser or in-app browser. It carries a signed token that tells the OAuth service who is connecting.

expires_at.description: The link stops working after this (10 minutes)
